# Vite config and CSS nesting build warnings
The zhi2-mobile-shimin project had build warnings from duplicate vite sourcemap keys, CSS nesting, and local SVG paths; fixes eliminated warnings.
## Root cause
- vite.config.ts had duplicate sourcemap key; changed to unified platform-based condition.
- PropertyCard.vue and other Vue files used CSS nesting; expanded to full selectors for Chrome 53 compatibility.
- flag-szf.svg in ResultStatistics.vue and StepConfirm.vue used local path; switched to CDN URL.
- browserslist db was stale; ran `npx update-browserslist-db`.
## Solution
- Unified vite sourcemap config by platform.
- Rewrote nested CSS as explicit selectors in PropertyCard.vue, property-detail.vue, company-detail.vue, data-analysis.vue.
- Replaced local svg with CDN in ResultStatistics.vue, StepConfirm.vue.
- Updated browserslist database.
## Verification
- Source: session 5ca7c165-a429-40a7-a5eb-a5c94b398242; baseline none; from 苏住房C/062.md.
- Involved files: vite.config.ts, index.html, src/page-query/data-analysis.vue, PropertyCard.vue, property-detail.vue, company-detail.vue, ResultStatistics.vue, StepConfirm.vue.

# Inline relative icon path fails on H5
add.vue used inline :style with hardcoded relative icon path, breaking under Vite build and H5 base './'; fixed via resolveStaticUrl with import.meta.env.BASE_URL.
## Root cause
- pages_owner/repair/add.vue categorized icons using inline :style with relative path strings.
- Relative paths bypassed Vite build and, with H5 base './', WebView resolved them incorrectly.
## Solution
- Introduced resolveStaticUrl based on import.meta.env.BASE_URL to generate correct paths.
- Applied in add.vue, immediate-list.vue, info.vue, IdentityEntry.vue, utils/index.js.
- Updated vite.config.ts and pages.json as needed.
## Verification
- Source session 80e004b0-7fee-4cde-af50-62f07a822d3a; baseline none; from 苏住房C/062.md.
- Involved files: add.vue, utils/index.js, immediate-list.vue, info.vue, IdentityEntry.vue, pages.json, vite.config.ts.

# Login page subpackage migration old path jump
pages/login moved to pages_main/login with new pages.json registration, but old jump paths caused page not found; unified to new path.
## Root cause
- Login page relocated from pages/login to pages_main/login; pages.json registered new route.
- Multiple code locations still navigated to legacy '/pages/login/index', triggering page not found.
## Solution
- Updated all navigation targets to '/pages_main/login/index' including src/utils/index.js, route-map.js, redirect/index.vue, FormLocal.vue.
- Adjusted migrate-pages-tab.mjs and component files accordingly.
## Verification
- Source session 73f5531d-ca8f-4227-9e76-d2fa4b5c98a1; baseline none; from 苏住房C/062.md.
- Involved files: pages.json, migrate-pages-tab.mjs, pages/login/index.vue, pages_main/login/index.vue, utils/index.js, route-map.js, redirect/index.vue, FormLocal.vue.

# 构建裁剪脚本正则与 uni.scss 强耦合致主包超限
zhi2-mobile-shimin 构建后 prune-component-wxss-leak.mjs 的 LEAK_END 正则匹配 uni.scss 全局类，uni.scss 改动后正则失效致组件 wxss 泄漏。

## 现象与根因
- npm run build 时 size:main 报 MAIN 上传预估 2110.8KB OVER LIMIT（限制 2048KB），但磁盘体积 1804.1KB 正常。
- 根因：uni-app 把 uni.scss 全局样式注入每个组件 wxss；裁剪脚本用 LEAK_END 正则定位删除片段。本次 uni.scss 新增 .container/.success-page 且 min-height:100% 改 inherit，正则未匹配，32 组件各泄漏约 8.3KB 合计 267KB。
- 「磁盘 ok、上传预估 over」差值约 300KB 即泄漏信号。

## 解决方案
- 改 uni.scss 全局类名/属性值时同步检查 prune-component-wxss-leak.mjs 正则，兼容新增类名与 min-height 两种取值。
- 修复后 components 从 431.6KB 降到 164.6KB，上传预估降到 1798.4KB。
- 日常可单独跑 npm run size:main 快速验体积（validate-dist 末尾自动跑）。

## 验证与归属
- 验证：会话 ec247072（基线 6aca310）构建报 OVER LIMIT；更新正则兼容 .container/.success-page 与 min-height:inherit 后 components 431.6KB→164.6KB、MAIN 磁盘 1804.1KB→1537.1KB、上传预估→1798.4KB ok。
- 涉及文件：scripts/prune-component-wxss-leak.mjs、src/uni.scss、scripts/size-main-package.mjs、src/pages.json
- 所属项目：苏住房C；来源会话ID：ec247072-d32c-44f5-838a-cfbdfe935169；代码基线：6aca310。
